newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas names two executives.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas names two executives.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp Thursday announced two executive assignments at its defense division and its corporate office.

The company named Robert Brand vice president/general manager-business management for its McDonnell Douglas Aerospace unit, effective February 1. McDonnell Douglas said Brand will become chief financial officer for the division, the company's largest business unit.
Brand succeeds Bill Austin, who is leaving the company after six years, McDonnell Douglas said.
The company also appointed Mark Schroeder to succeed Branda vice president and controller of the corporation.
McDonnell Douglas is a major aerospace engineering company. Its shares closed down 1/8 Thursday at 65-1/2.
